Title: Definition lifecycle invariant hardening
Purpose: Enforce the lifecycle rules that the Process services already assume: single draft, single published version, valid active published binding, and conflict-safe version allocation.
Deliverables: Schema-level enforcement for one draft per definition.
Schema-level enforcement for one published version per definition.
A safe binding strategy for `ActivePublishedVersionId`, preferably including same-definition enforcement.
A conflict-safe version allocator that does not use `MAX + 1`.
Retry-aware or otherwise hardened slug allocation semantics under uniqueness conflicts.
ReviewQuestions: Can the DB now enforce one draft and one published version per definition?
Can `ActivePublishedVersionId` no longer point to an invalid or foreign version without being rejected?
Did version allocation stop relying on `MAX + 1`?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If lifecycle singularity still exists only in ordering logic or if `MAX + 1` remains, fail and open the lifecycle corrective playbook before any closure work continues.
